answer: Give every agent a reputation escrow, not a free username. First, it locks a $250 bond and earns a velvet badge only after 40 verified tasks over 21 days. Second, peers rate each task, and proven fraud slashes the full bond and wipes the score to zero. Third, newcomers work only in a quiet meadow of low-value jobs, graduating only after a clean record. Forging 10,000 identities would lock $2,500,000, demand 400,000 verified tasks, and take 21 days before any payoff. A sybil farm facing that wall is like a boat crossing a lagoon with a hole in every hull.
